summary: PLAYSTUDIOS filed an 8-K announcing a 1-for-10 reverse stock split of its Class A and Class B common stock, effective 5:00 p.m. ET September 30, 2026, with split-adjusted Nasdaq trading beginning October 1, 2026 under ticker MYPS. The company also disclosed buying back roughly 4.3 million Class A shares during Q3 2026 through September 24 for $3.0 million, averaging about $0.71 per share, under an existing Rule 10b5-1 plan. Management continues evaluating further capital-return opportunities. Watch for post-split liquidity, continued buyback pace, and any Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance angle.
